question: Anita starts from her house at Point A and walks 5 m towards South. She takes a right turn, walks 7 m, takes another right and walks 12 m and stops at point P. If a pole is placed 7 m towards East from where she stopped (Point P), how far (shortest distance) and in which direction will her house be from the pole? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified.)
solution:

Anita starts from her house at Point A and walks 5 m towards South

If a pole is placed 7 m towards East from where she stopped (Point P)
